decisions.reason: As the publicly presented flagship product line with multiple models and a dedicated launch page, it has high sunk investment, visibility, and centrality, making withdrawal very unlikely under escalation of commitment.

The continuing education institute builds on the established offer and received public commitment, so management is inclined to justify and persist with it, though less strongly than for the flagship.

With only a website mention and no flagship status or strong centrality, this support tool shows the least investment and public commitment, making it the most likely to be discontinued to release resources.
